sources.quote: We use generative AI across all disciplines of game development, most often with heavy amounts of human editing. We also have a full soundtrack of 1950's halloween pop hits that are obviously made by AI, as you can hear in the trailer. It's awesome and it'd be basically impossible otherwise.
